production.note: US model years from 2025, still on sale (Ford.com offers the "2026 Ford Mustang® GTD", source ford-us-mustang-gtd-2026). MotorTrend's test covers the "2025 Ford Mustang GTD"; Autoweek's February 2025 report gives the weight of production cars (source autoweek-gtd-weight-2025).

body.note: Fixed-roof fastback coupe only; no convertible is offered.

displacementL.note: Ford states "5.2L". No opened page gives the cc figure.

drivetrain.note: Ford describes a "carbon‑fiber driveshaft" to a "rear‑mounted 8‑speed transaxle"; rear-wheel drive is inferred from that description.

transmission.note: "Paired with an eight‑speed dual‑clutch for instant shifts." Rear-mounted transaxle; MotorTrend: "Tremec dual-clutch transaxle" (source motortrend-gtd-test-2026).

powerHp.note: Quote, Ford.com: "Experience the adrenaline-fueled thrill of 815 HP & a 202 mph top speed with the track-dominating 2026 Ford Mustang® GTD." The same rating applied from launch: Carscoops, September 16, 2024, "The supercharged 5.2-liter V8 engine is now officially rated at 815 hp (608 kW / 826 PS) and 664 lb-ft (900 Nm) of torque" (source carscoops-gtd-815hp-2024).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL, a single article quoting a Ford statement. Base car. Quote (Autoweek, Wesley Wren, February 21, 2025): "Mustang GTD, the first car from an American brand to lap the Nürburgring in under 7 minutes, has a base curb weight of approximately 4,340 lbs." (attributed to Ford). The same article reports the EPA certification figure: "the EPA certification sheet pegs the Mustang GTD's curb weight at 4,343 pounds" (0.1% apart; the EPA document itself was not opened). Ford.com gives no figure ("It weighs the perfect amount ... 'less.'"). MotorTrend weighed an optioned test car ($438,200 as tested) at 4,411 lb, a tested figure for a heavier car, 1.6% above (source motortrend-gtd-test-2026).

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 4,340 lb rests on a single article (Autoweek, 21 February 2025) quoting a Ford spokesperson's "approximately 4,340 lbs", with the EPA certification figure of 4,343 lb reported in the same article. A Ford specification sheet with the GTD curb weight, or a major magazine's specification panel giving the manufacturer figure, would replace it. Power (815 hp) is from Ford.com.
